messages.author: Rui Saldanha
messages.text: Standard queue tickets on the 26th — that only works for a July week. Rush tickets on the 12th and the travellers are confirmed the next business day. Tiago and Camila are basic fares: forfeited, new tickets at 330.

messages.author: Maeve Dunne
messages.text: I am on approved leave 6-10 July; the 6 July week is a no for me and I am required.

messages.author: Maren Achterberg
messages.text: AP-DK-0104 allows rush up to 300. Buying open-market fares above the caps through Northlane is not approved — that is Rui and Ifeoma. The agenda rev 2 on the drive is the old two-day version; rev 3 is current.
